params.name: aColumns
params.description: Populated with the columns that have a sort order (in cross-table mode: at most 2 elements, 1=columns, 2=rows)

params.name: aOrders
params.description: Populated with the sort order matching each element of aColumns: 1 = ascending, -1 = descending

overloads.semanticRole: Populates aColumns with every column that has a sort order and the parallel array aOrders with each column's sort direction.

jointConstraints.rule: aColumns and aOrders are parallel arrays: aOrders{n} gives the sort direction for the column referenced by aColumns{n}.

constraints: In cross-table mode, aColumns/aOrders cannot have more than two elements, since sorts can only be performed on columns (1) and rows (2).
